description:
About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico Retail team is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our team. As Vendor Manager, you'll work with different vendors to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

Key job responsibilities

You’ll be responsible for looking after a brand’s product portfolio, contributing to improvements in the user experience for customers and creating detailed monthly reports on performance. You’ll lead presentations and planning sessions with vendors and act as the main point of contact for them.

You will also provide support to drive category growth through detailed analysis of business inefficiencies and identifying solutions; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality product detail pages; and making recommendations for effective marketing campaigns.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 5+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience
 2+ years of market research analyst, product manager, or equivalent experience
 2+ years of doing one of several roles: quantitative/financial analysis, retail buying, retail planning & allocation, product/project management, pricing, marketing or e-commerce experience
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
 +2 YOE driving internal cross-team collaboration
 Bachelor's Degree.


Preferred Qualifications


 3+ years of doing one of several roles: management consulting, investment banking analyst/associate, or brand manager role at leading consumer packaged goods company experience
 Experience in financial analysis, retail buying, retail planning & allocation, product/project management, marketing, business development, consulting, negotiation or supply chain

Our product is our impact. We are deeply focused on measurable outcomes and building products that create meaningful, lasting change in people’s lives.

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Lead Software Development Engineer, it’s up to you to define, design and refine the tech that keeps us one step ahead of listeners. Anticipate. Innovate. Bring challenging ideas and we’ll support you with the latest tech, tools and systems that you need to succeed. You’ll drive the team forward, guiding them over every obstacle and leading the way to develop exciting, original and effective solutions. Leading the way, you’ll bring our team together to build and maintain our platform to bring thousands of stories to millions of listeners and unleash the power of the human voice.

Joining our team provides the unique challenge and opportunity to deliver software that benefits many customers around the world. Marketing Technology (MarTech) team's mission is to develop systems and tools that enable marketers to provide customers multi-touch, personalized and timely messages that enhance the experience of using our services. Customer journey automation and real-time targeting are examples of systems that the team works on. These systems are built using cutting edge technologies and products from AWS like Kinesis, S3, EMR, Elastic Search, etc.

About You

You’re in your element when you’re being challenged, and you’re always eager to share your ideas, take on responsibility and keep developing at an exciting pace. We look for people who show initiative, set their standards high and see every failure as an opportunity to learn. You’re looking for an environment where you can thrive and help your team reach their potential. With opportunities to challenge yourself and lead a talented team to success, you’ll find what you’re looking for at Audible.

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Being part of the Marketing team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest-growing companies ever. Be prepared for a hectic, fast-paced, and challenging environment. Never a dull moment!

You will be constantly seeking solutions that scale, while overseeing the growth of our business. Your processes and projects will directly contribute to DiDi's growth in Mexico!

In this role, you'll be...


A creative, analytical, and motivated person who wants to begin a career in the Marketing team.
Providing significant support to the Marketing Manager in the Marketing Daily User Campaigns, Analytics, and Reporting. 
Deep diving into customer service interactions to identify qualitative insights and improvement opportunities.
Supporting market research and A/B tests to identify opportunities.
Benchmarking analysis and reporting, highlighting relevant insights. 
Supporting Marketing campaigns impacting traffic, growth, and engagement.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Students of bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Administration or Business. 
Fluent in English and Spanish.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
Knowledge and interest in data analysis applied to business and marketing.
Deeper interest in Marketing Strategy. 
Interest in a hands-on team player role, as well as a self-driven way of working.
Creative and analytical thinking. 
Decision-making based on data and insights.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Estamos buscando un Field Marketing Specialist para nuestro equipo en México, con ganas de impulsar el crecimiento local y llevar nuestras iniciativas de marketing al siguiente nivel. Buscamos a alguien con perfil analítico, proactivo y con comodidad para trabajar en un entorno ágil, capaz de ejecutar y dar seguimiento a iniciativas de marketing alineadas con los objetivos del negocio.

La persona en este rol será la responsable de generar e implementar estrategias y programas integrales de eventos y experiencias, hospitalidad, vinculación con asociaciones industriales e iniciativas de branding, para acelerar el crecimiento del negocio. Dentro de las responsabilidades, se encuentra la gestión de presupuesto, manejo de proveedores y análisis para la optimización continua de resultados.

¿Qué tendrás que hacer?


Tu principal objetivo en este rol será generar y acelerar oportunidades de negocio a través de un programa de eventos y experiencias integral, que ayude a lograr los objetivos de negocio. 
Garantizar un retorno de inversión en la inversión de marketing en eventos y experiencias, a través de la gestión y optimización del presupuesto. 
Actuar como partner estratégico/a del equipo comercial (Payments Consultants y BDRs), entendiendo sus desafíos y desarrollando acciones que aceleren la creación de pipeline y el cierre de oportunidades. 
Articular propuestas de valor específicas por industria y vertical de negocio, asegurando que estén correctamente adaptadas al mercado mexicano e industrias target. 
Coordinar y ejecutar eventos (externos y propios) junto a agencias y stakeholders locales, maximizando su impacto en ventas y posicionamiento. 
Identificar asociaciones industriales relevantes, y buscar vinculaciones institucionales para Toku, con enfoque en posicionamiento dentro del ecosistema y desarrollo de negocio. 
Gestionar relación con proveedores y agencias, garantizando la consistencia de la marca y la calidad de los materiales vinculados con la marca. 
Colaborar con el equipo de marketing regional para adaptar mensajes clave y producir materiales estratégicos. 
Medir y analizar resultados de todas las iniciativas de field marketing en México. 


¿Qué necesitamos de ti?

✔ Al menos 2 años de experiencia en marketing.

✔ Perfil hands-on, con capacidad de convertir ideas y conceptos en realidad, priorizar y adaptarse en un entorno dinámico.

✔ Experiencia en gestión de presupuesto y coordinación con proveedores y agencias externas.

✔ Persona colaborativa, con fuerte atención al detalle, orientación al trabajo en equipo y a la coordinación con distintos stakeholders.

description:
About the job

Are you a LaTeX expert fluent in Spanish (Spain) eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of scientific discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, enhance academic publishing, and streamline document preparation for researchers and professionals everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for LaTeX specialists who live and breathe document typesetting, mathematical formatting, bibliographic management, package customization, template development, and cross-referencing techniques. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like complex equation formatting, multi-language document support, Beamer presentations, TikZ graphics, package troubleshooting, and collaborative editing workflows—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on document preparation scenarios and theoretical LaTeX questions, verify formatting accuracy and logical consistency, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related field is ideal; professional experience in academic publishing, technical writing, or scientific communication signals fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential. Fluency in Spanish (Spain) is required.

Ready to turn your LaTeX expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $8‑to‑$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues
Communicate resolutions to end users in English
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience 
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features 
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate 
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from ground up and make a real impact on the future organization 
Be a part of building a brand new team and operational culture for Stripe 
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You have business proficiency in written and spoken English 
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving
You might have prior experience in customer service or internal/external user facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you are an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross team collaboration and support
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you will receive a weekday off; the SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support 
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives 
Familiarity with SQL and ability to use template or premade SQL queries as part of investigations



Applicants are personally responsible for obtaining and maintaining the right to work in Mexico.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

title: Growth Engineer o Head of Growth
description:
About the job

Sobre el puesto:




En buscamos un Head of Growth / Growth Engineer con alto perfil técnico y analítico, enfocado en diseñar, implementar y escalar estrategias de adquisición masiva, retención y monetización para plataformas digitales con modelo de suscripción recurrente (Freemium, Free Trial y conversión a pago).




Buscamos a alguien con mentalidad científica, obsesionado con los datos, la experimentación continua y la automatización de flujos de crecimiento dentro del producto.




Responsabilidades Principales:

- Diseñar e implementar Growth Loops (mecanismos de viralidad, retención de cohortes y conversión estratégica).

- Optimizar el Onboarding y el Time-to-Value (TTV) para maximizar la tasa de conversión Free-to-Paid.

- Instrumentar eventos y analítica de producto avanzada (Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog, Segment o herramientas afines).

- Diseñar, ejecutar y analizar experimentos A/B rigurosos en funnels de registro, paywalls, esquemas de precios y activación de usuarios.

- Definir e implementar estrategias para reducir el Churn y maximizar la retención (Net Revenue Retention > 100%).

- Conectar e integrar pipelines de datos, webhooks y automatizaciones con la arquitectura técnica del producto.




Requisitos y Competencias Técnicas:

- Experiencia demostrable escalando plataformas digitales con modelo de suscripción masiva (B2C o B2B PLG).

- Dominio de analítica de producto, segmentación por comportamientos y métricas de retención por cohortes.

- Background técnico o capacidad para interactuar directamente con APIs, scripts, bases de datos y herramientas de experimentación.

- Dominio comprobado de métricas clave de crecimiento: LTV, CAC, MRR/ARR, Free-to-Paid Conversion Rate y Retention Rate.




¿Por qué unirte a nosotros?

Formarás parte de un equipo enfocado en la innovación tecnológica y el crecimiento exponencial, diseñando sistemas de escala directa para productos digitales.

About the job

Description

We are looking for motivated, customer-focused people who want to join our team as a Reliability Maintenance Engineering Planner. The Reliability Maintenance Engineering Planner is responsible for asset and spares management, preventative maintenance planning and machine history data. They are the site lead for the CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) software and are required to extract information from it to support the site engineering manager.

Key job responsibilities

Be the site level SME (Subject Matter Expert) on the CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) software, train the local engineering team in its use and escalate issues as required to the Global team.

Ensure the system is run in line with IntlRME standards and participate in IntlRME coordinated projects and improvement programs to roll out new functionality, procedures, scheduling or reports.

Ensure site level equipment, spare parts and minimum holding levels are correctly recorded in the system in order to ensure technicians are never without the parts they need.

Ensure the system accurately forecasts and assigns all required preventative maintenance to technicians within the team to provide a high level of equipment availability to our internal customers.

Compile equipment information, performance metrics and machine histories and make recommendations for improvements based on their findings.

Manage spare parts stock levels, place and track orders as required. Work with procurement and the wider network to find savings or efficiencies.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 Bachelor's degree
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English

description:
About the job

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.

To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to support and drive our Customer Success teams regionally. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success management and an obvious passion for new technologies.

You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you will provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You will play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. Comfortable dealing with ambiguity you will be equip to quickly adapt to change. Collaboration with other teams is also vital to this role to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility will be to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work in close collaboration with the Global Head of Customer Success to drive results.

We engage with a diverse customer base and follow a diverse set of motions to provide the appropriate and required level of focus for every customer. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the ability to pivot right across this customer base regardless of culture, location or focus.

Location: These opportunities are available in the APAC and AMER regions and are remote positions.

The role entails:


Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, team meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You will develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive up-sells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
Customer interactions and support to your team: resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention ensuring timely resolution.
Team management: passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. Conducting regular performance reviews with team members you will also help identifying areas for improvement/development as well as celebrating excellence, recognising team achievements, and setting goals for individual growth. 
Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You will establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you will also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.



What We Are Looking For In You


Excellent academic results at school and university
Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM subject
Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
Experience growing and developing a CSM team
Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events



Nice-to-have Skills


Whilst English is our business language, proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, or French will be valued.



What We Offer You

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.


Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. description:
About the job

Una de las decisiones más emocionantes y significativas en la vida es elegir dónde vas a vivir. Por eso creamos EasyBroker: para darle a los asesores inmobiliarios las herramientas que necesitan para prosperar y ofrecer un servicio excepcional, haciendo que comprar o rentar sea simple y sin estrés. Hoy apoyamos a más de 15,000 profesionales, con más de 500,000 propiedades y más de 3,000 sitios web creados con nuestra plataforma.

Aunque empezamos en 2007, trabajamos como una startup: equipo pequeño, remoto, muy talentoso y con un enfoque radical en crear productos que importan. Valoramos el criterio, el buen gusto, la autonomía y la capacidad de llevar proyectos de principio a fin. Aquí no eres una pieza más: das forma a las ideas, hablas con usuarios cuando hace falta, propones soluciones y tienes un impacto real en el producto y en el negocio.

Ahora estamos apostando fuerte por Pincali, nuestro nuevo marketplace con el que queremos convertirnos en el mejor lugar para comprar o rentar tu hogar en México. Es un proyecto ambicioso diseñado para crecer rápido: nuestra meta es multiplicar por diez los ingresos en tres años. Y, a diferencia de muchas startups, tenemos algo que prácticamente nadie más tiene:


17 años de experiencia profunda en el sector.
Una red enorme de asesores inmobiliarios gracias a EasyBroker.
Un equipo de producto y tecnología muy bueno.
Los recursos para financiar y construir Pincali nosotros mismos, sin inversión externa.


Eso nos coloca en una posición extraordinaria: tenemos una probabilidad muy alta de que Pincali sea un éxito masivo. Y quienes se unan ahora tendrán la oportunidad de crecer junto con el proyecto y beneficiarse directamente del impacto que generen. Es una de esas ventanas únicas donde el riesgo es bajo y el potencial es extremadamente alto.

Si te inspira la idea de construir algo grande, asumir verdadera responsabilidad y trabajar con gente talentosa en un producto con enorme potencial, aquí puedes hacer el mejor trabajo de tu carrera. Queremos que quienes se unan ahora crezcan tanto como la empresa y que se beneficien de manera importante del éxito que estamos construyendo juntos.

¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir nuestra misión?

EasyBroker llegó hasta donde está en gran medida porque los agentes inmobiliarios se lo recomiendan entre sí. Detrás de eso hay un equipo que conoce de cerca el reto de ser agente inmobiliario en México: sus presiones, su forma de trabajar y lo que necesitan para hacer crecer su negocio. Nuestro equipo de Customer Success convierte ese conocimiento en confianza, y esa confianza en lealtad.

Resolverás dudas técnicas, investigarás problemas complejos y ayudarás a identificar oportunidades de mejora para el producto. A veces eso implicará revisar configuraciones avanzadas o entender qué está ocurriendo dentro de un sitio web; otras, detectar que un problema reportado por un usuario en realidad refleja una necesidad más amplia que vale la pena escalar al resto del equipo.

Trabajarás en un equipo de Customer Success de cuatro personas con seniority, incluyendo a tu manager, la Head de Customer Success. También trabajarás muy cerca del equipo de Engineering, Product y Marketing, representando la voz del usuario dentro de EasyBroker de forma clara y fundamentada, transformando conversaciones cotidianas en mejoras reales para el producto y la experiencia de nuestros clientes.

En este rol, hacer las preguntas correctas es tan importante como dar las respuestas. Esperamos que investigues cuando algo no esté claro, que conectes información de distintas fuentes y que llegues con propuestas concretas para resolver problemas antes de que crezcan.

Buscamos personas curiosas, con criterio, capacidad técnica y mucha iniciativa. Personas capaces de desenvolverse en conversaciones complejas, identificar la necesidad detrás de una consulta y construir soluciones prácticas incluso cuando el problema no está completamente definido.

Respondabilidades

Investigar incidencias técnicas y diagnosticar su causa raíz, involucrando a otros equipos cuando sea necesario.
Identificar patrones recurrentes en las consultas de los usuarios y proponer mejoras al producto, procesos o documentación.
Documentar hallazgos, procesos y mejores prácticas para fortalecer el conocimiento interno del equipo.
Comunicar a Engineering, Product y Marketing de forma clara y estructurada problemas, necesidades y oportunidades detectadas en usuarios o en la compañía.
Dar seguimiento proactivo a casos complejos hasta su resolución.
Pitchear correctamente las herramientas de EasyBroker, integrando el producto a la realidad de la persona a la que le estás comunicando.
Capacitar a usuarios online y en persona para obtener el máximo valor de EasyBroker, entendiendo sus objetivos de negocio y contexto operativo.

Participar en iniciativas de mejora continua del área de Customer Success.

Delivering with excellence for our customers is of the utmost priority, and we are expanding our Services Customer Success team to achieve this goal. This team plays a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of our products and services. Customer Success (CS) boosts Customer Lifetime Value, increases renewals and adoption, reduces support tickets, improves product feedback, builds advocacy for B2B marketing, and generates qualified sales leads.

This team will work collaboratively with cross-functional partners to address customer needs, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, and build customer advocacy. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service, the Services Customer Success team fosters long-term relationships and contributes to the overall growth and safety of the Mastercard ecosystem.

 As a Customer Success Sr. Specialist for Services, you will support the development and delivery of strategic priorities within the region. The candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams including Network Services, Account Management, Sales, Product, Technical Account Managers and support/delivery teams to realize the full value proposition of Mastercard Network Products on behalf of the customer.

The three areas of primary responsibility include: 1) customer engagement, 2) growing the business, and 3) technical and program readiness.

Customer Engagement:


 Engage with stakeholders to study the viability of proposed solutions and understand cyber threats in financial and payment sectors
 Identify optimization opportunities for customers with the goals of driving customer value and enhanced strategic goals through our products
 Articulate key performance indicators related to cost, performance and optimization and the insights associated with them



Growing The Business:


 Leverage Mastercard Services’ offerings to achieve customer goals and realize value propositions of Mastercard products
 Identify opportunities for additional Mastercard products to create greater value potential for customers and enhance impact of Network Product offerings
 Ability to evaluate business models, partnerships, and agreements ensuring product business cases are financially viable and supported by solid data



Technical & Program Readiness:


 Develop training materials, thought leadership, and customer-facing playbooks that can be scaled internally and externally to support customer priorities and Customer Success value proposition
 Translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner
 Gather and report customer feedback on product gaps and pain points. Use stakeholder insights to refine value propositions and improve products



All About You:


 Experience managing clients or internal stakeholders
 Logical, structured thinking, and affinity for numerical analysis
 Experienced at leveraging insights from market analysis, customer engagements, and identified opportunities to inform strategic decisions, drive innovation, and sustain competitive advantage
 Knowledge and understanding of payments technology or cybersecurity (threat intelligence or risk management) and application of that knowledge to address customer/market needs in these areas are a plus
 Experience using tools and technology to provide data analytics and business intelligence on cyber threats, fraud, risk and vulnerability
 Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner

 Experience working with at least some of the following: large and emerging Technology, Financial Services, Acquirers/Processors, Service Providers, and/or digital platform partners
 English and Spanish (Portuguese highly desirable)

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Generate and distribute sales order confirmations to customers, ensuring clear communication of order details and fulfillment milestones.
Document, verify, and maintain records of any applicable third-party broker commissions associated with customer orders, ensuring accuracy and audit readiness.
Plan, select, and execute all outbound customer shipments, balancing, cost efficiency, service reliability, and customer-specific delivery requirements.
Monitor shipment progress from dispatch through final delivery, providing timely, proactive updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Coordinate closely with freight brokers, carriers, and warehouse partners to schedule shipments, resolve transit issues, mitigate delays, develop contingency plans to minimize customer impact.

description:
About the job

Principal Function: The Order Fulfillment Specialist - Customer Success plays a critical role in efficiently receiving, reviewing, and processing all inbound customer purchase orders. This position ensures seamless coordination between customers, sales and internal teams, facilitates accurate order entry and timely fulfillment, and contributes to maintaining organized, compliant, and accurate internal processes.




Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Duties include, but are not limited to:




1. Customer Order Processing

Receive, review, and validate customer purchase orders to ensure accuracy of pricing, contractual terms, delivery requirements, and compliance with internal policies.
Request and coordinate product allocation, confirm material availability, and enter customer orders accurately into internal systems while monitoring order status through fulfillment.
Proactively track and resolve order delays or discrepancies, collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, Planning, Finance and Customer Success teams to align on delivery timelines and customer expectations.
Generate and distribute sales order confirmations to customers, ensuring clear communication of order details and fulfillment milestones.
Document, verify, and maintain records of any applicable third-party broker commissions associated with customer orders, ensuring accuracy and audit readiness.

2. Customer Outbound Logistics

Plan, select, and execute all outbound customer shipments, balancing, cost efficiency, service reliability, and customer-specific delivery requirements.
Monitor shipment progress from dispatch through final delivery, providing timely, proactive updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Coordinate closely with freight brokers, carriers, and warehouse partners to schedule shipments, resolve transit issues, mitigate delays, develop contingency plans to minimize customer impact.
Identify recurring logistics challenges and contribute to continuous improvement efforts aimed at enhancing delivery performance, visibility, and overall customer satisfaction.

3. Customer Support

Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and a solutions-oriented approach that reinforces thrust and long-term partnership.
Act as an extension of the Sales team by supporting customer requests, identifying upsell or follow-on order opportunities, and ensuring seamless handoffs between Sales and Operations.
Communicate extensively with customers, carriers, brokers, and internal teams via high-volume email and time-sensitive phone calls, responding promptly to inquiries, issues, and escalation needs related to active orders and shipments.
Prepare, retrieve, and distribute customer-requested documentation such as invoices, packing lists, certificates, and shipping records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with customer and regulatory requirements.

4. Other

Carry out other duties to support departmental and organizational objectives.




Supervisory Responsibilities: This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty according to the requirements of the Company. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties and responsibilities.




Company-Related Competencies: To perform their jobs successfully, all employees working in the St. Louis Group should demonstrate the following competencies:

· Ethics – Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works ethically and with integrity; Upholds Company values.

· Professionalism – Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure; Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; Accepts responsibility for personal actions; Follows through on commitments.

· Problem Solving – Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

· Written and Oral Communication – Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; Listens and obtains clarification; Responds well to questions; Demonstrates group presentation skills; Participates in meetings; Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Reads with the ability to interpret written information.

· Teamwork – Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others’ views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone’s efforts to succeed.

· Adaptability – Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays or unexpected events.




Job-Related Competencies – To perform this job successfully, employees in this job should demonstrate the following competencies:

· Quality and Quantity – Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality; Meets productivity standards; Completes work in timely manner; Strives to increase productivity; Works quickly but efficiently.

· Customer Service – Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; Responds promptly to customer needs; Solicits customer feedback to improve service; Responds to requests for service and assistance; Meets commitments.

· Dependability – Follows instructions; Responds to management direction; Takes responsibility for own actions; Keeps commitments; Commits to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals; Completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan.

· Organizational Support – Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization’s goals and values; Benefits organization through outside activities; Supports affirmative action and respects diversity.

· Attendance/Punctuality – Is consistently at work and is on time; Ensures work responsibilities are covered when absent; Arrives at meetings and appointments on time.




Education and/or Experience: Bachelor's Degree and two-years related experience and/or training in an corporate office setting; or equivalent combination of education and experience.




Other Skills and Abilities: The following skills and abilities are either required or desired.

· Computer software skills including: Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel), Adobe, and Slack messaging software are required. The ability to quickly adapt and embrace new software is required.

· The ability to develop positive working relationships and interact effectively with vendors, brokers, customers, and colleagues is required.

· The ability to effectively listen and communicate orally and in writing is required.

· The ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously is required.

· The ability to prepare reports and forms is required.

· The ability to follow all established protocols, guidelines, and departmental policies is required.

· The ability to work alone with minimum supervision and with others in a team environment is required.

· The ability to work rapidly for long periods, under time pressure, and on several tasks at the same time is required.

· The ability to remain calm, perform duties, and make sound and rational decisions, including exercising independent judgment within established protocols and guidelines is required.

· The ability to be sensitive to professional ethics, gender, cultural diversities and disabilities is required.




· A working knowledge of standard office practices and the ability to apply such knowledge to a variety of interrelated processes, tasks, and operations is required.

· The ability to operate a computer, printer, telephone/switchboard, calculator, postage meter, copy machine, scanner, fax machine, shredder, and other office equipment is required.

· The ability to speak, read and write in English is required. Spanish is desired.

· The ability to occasionally travel out-of-town on Company-related business and/or to attend conferences and trainings, is desired.




Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties and responsibilities. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be exposed to the risk of electrical shock when working with the St. Louis Group office equipment. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate. While the offices of the St. Louis Group are usually open from 9:00a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, this position may require work beyond these hours and on the weekends

description:
About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Specialist, Customer Success Operations & Enablement

Overview

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution.

Delivering with excellence for our customers is of the utmost priority, and we are expanding our Services Customer Success team to achieve this goal. This team plays a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of our products and services. Customer Success (CS) boosts Customer Lifetime Value, increases renewals and adoption, reduces support tickets, improves product feedback, builds advocacy for B2B marketing, and generates qualified sales leads.

This team will work collaboratively with cross-functional partners to address customer needs, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, and build customer advocacy. Key outcomes of the CS team’s work will be qualified leads for value expansion and feedback for product and process improvements. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service, the Services Customer Success team fosters long-term relationships and contributes to the overall growth and safety of the Mastercard ecosystem.

 As a Customer Success Sr. Specialist for Services, you will support the development and delivery of strategic priorities within the region. The candidate will focus on ensuring the priority customers and segments they work with experience positive change through more effective use of Services network products. The candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams including Network Services, Account Management, Sales, Product, Technical Account Managers and support/delivery teams to realize the full value proposition of Mastercard Network Products on behalf of the customer.

The three areas of primary responsibility include: 1) customer engagement, 2) growing the business, and 3) technical and program readiness.

Customer Engagement:


 Engage with stakeholders to study the viability of proposed solutions and understand cyber threats in financial and payment sectors
 Identify optimization opportunities for customers with the goals of driving customer value and enhanced strategic goals through our products
 Articulate key performance indicators related to cost, performance and optimization and the insights associated with them



Growing The Business:


 Leverage Mastercard Services’ offerings to achieve customer goals and realize value propositions of Mastercard products
 Identify opportunities for additional Mastercard products to create greater value potential for customers and enhance impact of Network Product offerings
 Ability to evaluate business models, partnerships, and agreements ensuring product business cases are financially viable and supported by solid data



Technical & Program Readiness:


 Develop training materials, thought leadership, and customer-facing playbooks that can be scaled internally and externally to support customer priorities and Customer Success value proposition
 Translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner
 Gather and report customer feedback on product gaps and pain points. Use stakeholder insights to refine value propositions and improve products



All About You:


 Experience managing clients or internal stakeholders
 Logical, structured thinking, and affinity for numerical analysis
 Advanced Word, Excel, and PowerPoint skills
 Undergraduate degree with work experience in consulting, corporate strategy, business intelligence, business line management, or product management
 Experienced at leveraging insights from market analysis, customer engagements, and identified opportunities to inform strategic decisions, drive innovation, and sustain competitive advantage
 Knowledge and understanding of payments technology or cybersecurity (threat intelligence or risk management) and application of that knowledge to address customer/market needs in these areas are a plus
 Experience using tools and technology to provide data analytics and business intelligence on cyber threats, fraud, risk and vulnerability
 Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner
 Experience in analyzing customer metrics and leveraging data to drive customer success initiatives that contribute to mutual profitability and growth
 Experience in identifying “next opportunity” for customers to further enhance the strength and value of the partnership for both parties
 Experience in creative thinking and development of innovative solutions to complex customer challenges
 Enthusiastic individual who works seamlessly with a diverse high performing team, nurtures a winning and inclusive culture, and a focus on development at the individual and team level
 Experience working with at least some of the following: large and emerging Technology, Financial Services, Acquirers/Processors, Service Providers, and/or digital platform partners



Spanish and fluent English (advanced Portuguese highly desirable)

Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

Are you excited about driving impactful creative programs that elevate the Amazon Music

brand and customer experience? Are you driven by the challenge of building and

optimizing end-to-end program management frameworks to streamline creative

workflows and unlock efficiencies? Do you want to hone your skills in enabling and

improving processes alongside a global team of content creators and design experts? If so,

the Amazon Music Design & Creative Operations team is looking for a talented, passionate

Creative Operations Manager with a track record of strategic program delivery, cross-

functional collaboration, and process improvement to support the Brand & Creative

Strategy team.

Key job responsibilities


 Support team of brand strategists and copywriters in capacity planning across campaigns, creative and internal team needs

 Support workflows for internal initiatives and larger campaigns

A day in the life

We're growing quickly and hiring the best talent to drive our creative vision forward. This

is an exciting opportunity to join our Amazon Music Design and Creative Operations team

as a Creative Operations Manager managing work within our Brand Creative Copy &

Strategy space. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and optimizing key

programs that span creative marketing, product and brand strategy launches. You will

serve as a central creative operational hub, building the frameworks, governance

structures, and cross-functional collaboration mechanisms required to successfully deliver

strategic creative initiatives.

About The Team

The Design and Creative Operations team is an embedded within the overall Design

organization, striving and focusing on operational excellence across all business verticals

within Amazon Music. The Design and Creative Operations team is responsible for

establishing the end-to-end workflow and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for

creative collaboration with all marketing, product, and partner design teams. We set the

standard for the process, earning trust with all partners, biasing for action when working

within tight parameters, and using sound judgment to make decisions in areas of ambiguity

or uncharted territories. Importantly, Design and Creative Operations also play a key role

in high-level reporting, defining and tracking key performance metrics, and maintaining

comprehensive documentation on our operational processes and best practices. They

partner closely with our counterparts in Brand Creative and Brand Strategy, along with

R&B and Product Design to launch bar-raising experiences across events, livestreams,

features, promotions and the product itself.

Basic Qualifications


 Knowledge of the workflow within a marketing, production, or creative department or company
 Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
 Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
 3+ year of experience in creative production, program coordination, or similar role


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience and understanding of the workflow within a marketing, production, or creative department or company
 Experience in Adobe Creative Suite applications, with high proficiency in Adobe WorkFront
 Workflow and process optimization through AI tooling

CEO Orlando Osorio: Consulted for 100+ startups including unicorns like CloudKitchens and BetterUp, angel-backed by Michael Seibel (ex-CEO of Y Combinator)
CTO Alberto Sadde: Led engineering at AI-powered companies serving Fortune 100 clients, Oxford PhD dropout who chose to build in the startup world
Web & Growth Director Ana Alida Abdala (Ali): Scaled Konfío (Mexican unicorn) from 50 to 1,000+ employees, performance marketing expert with deep martech capabilities




We're intentionally small: a 45-person team of specialists who've worked with companies like Raycast, CloudKitchens, NameCheap, Klar, Platzi, SamCart, Kueski, Cashea, and Endeavor.




For every client, 1–2 directors are deeply involved to provide hands-on guidance and support.




We're deeply embedded in the tech ecosystem:




Official host of Growth Conference → growthconf.com
Continuous builders: supervisible.com, savedtask.com
Angel investors & LPs: 0bs, Nascent, 500, Rainforest
Mentors at Endeavor and 500 Startups




The Mission

We're looking for someone who lives in the data and can prove, not guess, what moves conversion. You'll own the experimentation roadmap for our clients: forming sharp hypotheses, designing rigorous tests, and reporting results, including the honest "inconclusive", with full statistical confidence. This is a skeptical, analytical role, not a design or copy role.


What You'll Own

Mine analytics and user research to find friction points worth testing
Write clear hypotheses and prioritize a live test backlog
Design experiments: define sample size, success metric, and test structure before launch
Analyze results for statistical significance and turn them into client-ready findings
Defend or kill a test on the numbers alone, live, in front of a sharp client
Train the broader team on CRO fundamentals, hypothesis writing, and how to read test data


What You'll Need

Strong, hands-on background in A/B testing, you've run tests in the past
Comfort with experiment design and statistics: significance, sample size, multi-variant judgment
Analytics depth (GA4, segmentation) and research tooling (heatmaps, session recordings)
Ability to set up tracking/QA so a test actually measures what it claims to measure
Professional English, you'll present findings directly to clients


Nice to Have

Background in paid/performance marketing
CRO certifications or structured training (e.g. CXL)
Familiarity with Webflow, Framer or similar platforms, enough to understand what's testable


What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you've audited at least one client's analytics setup, shipped your first properly-powered test, and can walk a client through a result; win, loss, or inconclusive, leaning heavily on your quantitative and qualitative results.


Where We See This Person Coming From

Paid / performance marketer who lives close to data and understands significance instinctively
Data or web analyst with strong segmentation and reporting skills, ready to grow into hypothesis-driven work
Growth or product manager with a data-driven track record and genuine analytical curiosity

description:
About the job

Role summary

The Consumer & Retail Performance Lead owns performance interpretation for the consumer and retail/eTail motion. This role turns demand and conversion signals into early, credible insight so leadership can identify drift, understand implications, and take action before issues become material.

This person will build a repeatable view of retail performance health, detect emerging deviations, and frame them clearly for decision-making. The role is intentionally bounded: it does not own media buying, campaign execution, or retail partnership management. Its mandate is to provide trustworthy interpretation and escalation based on available signals and stated confidence.

Key responsibilities


Monitor consumer and retail demand and conversion signals across relevant channels
Build and maintain a stable weekly retail performance snapshot
Identify emerging risks, directional drift, and deviations early
Translate fragmented signal inputs into a clear business narrative for leadership
Explicitly label signal confidence and visibility constraints, including offline gaps
Escalate material deviations when they may affect targets, credibility, or portfolio trade-offs
Recommend intervention direction within scope, such as focus shifts, prioritization signals, or deeper diagnostic review
Partner with governance and performance teams to package insights for forums and follow-through tracking
Help advance KPI standards and interpretation methods for environments with partial visibility


What you will own


Retail and consumer performance interpretation
Weekly retail performance and deviation snapshots
Directional drift and health indicators for leadership review
Decision-ready framing of emerging consumer/retail risks


What you will not own


Media buying
Retail execution
Partner or channel relationship management
Final business ownership of commercial outcomes


Qualifications


Strong understanding of retail, eTail, or consumer funnel performance
Experience interpreting performance trends across demand and conversion metrics
Ability to work credibly with incomplete or imperfect data
Strong judgment in distinguishing directional signals from confirmed performance outcomes
Clear written and verbal communication, especially with senior stakeholders
Experience building recurrent performance views, dashboards, or operating cadences
High discipline in scope boundaries and governance-oriented ways of working


What success looks like


Retail deviations are surfaced earlier and discussed with greater consistency
Leadership has a stable, trusted view of consumer/retail health
Performance discussions become more evidence-based and less anecdotal
Drift signals are framed clearly without over-claiming beyond available visibility
Consumer/retail issues are escalated earlier and with better consequence framing


Complexity


 Provides highly innovative solutions to complex problems within established policy.

About the job

Paid Media Video Editor (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook)

Remote | Full-time or Part time | Fluent English Required

Time: 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (Hours are flexible, we care about performance not clocks).

Salary: $800 - $1,500 USD/month based on experience + performance bonuses




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a woman-owned sunglasses brand designed in NYC. We don't make glasses that just look good, we make glasses that solve problems. Our tangle-free aviators, floating sunglasses, foldable shades, UV400 lenses, and shatter-resistant designs are built for real people. We're a small, remote team, which means we move fast and every person we bring on has a real impact.




We are growing. That growth is driven by performance creative ads that convert, content that earns attention, and a team that understands the difference between looking good and actually selling.




Our biggest opportunity right now is creative execution: producing high-volume, high-quality video content that captures attention and drives revenue. We already have a growing library of UGC, influencer content, product footage, and internal creative assets. What we need is someone who can turn those assets into ads that make people stop scrolling, understand why they need the product, and click “Buy.” 




The Role

We are looking for a Paid Media Video Editor to join our growing marketing team. This is not a traditional video editing role.




You will not simply take footage and make it look polished. This is a performance creative role where video editing is the primary skill, but the ultimate goal is to drive clicks, conversions, and revenue. If your mindset is purely aesthetic, this may not be the right fit. If you think about hooks, buyer psychology, value propositions, retention, and conversion while you edit, we want to hear from you.




Your primary responsibility will be transforming raw footage, including UGC, influencer content, product footage, and internal shoots, into scroll-stopping, conversion-focused video ads for Meta, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.




We do not need cinematic edits for the sake of looking cinematic. We need clear, smart, persuasive short-form videos that capture attention, communicate value, and make people want to click “Buy.”




You will work under the Marketing Manager and collaborate closely with the broader marketing, paid media, social media, influencer, and creative teams.




This is a high-ownership role with significant room for growth. As you demonstrate strong performance, strategic thinking, and leadership, there is an opportunity to grow into senior performance creative, creative strategy, or creative leadership.




Here is the exact type of videos looking for you to make:

https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?active_status=active&ad_type=all&country=ALL&is_targeted_country=false&media_type=all&search_type=page&sort_data[direction]=desc&sort_data[mode]=total_impressions&view_all_page_id=441539569357988 




Your primary mission:

Turn products, offers, and real customer stories into video ads that make people stop scrolling, understand the value of the product, and take action. Every edit you make should serve a business goal.




Your primary focus will be paid advertising on Meta and TikTok, with additional support for organic social content when needed.




What You’ll Do: 

1) Paid Advertising Creative (Primary Focus)

Create vertical video ads for Meta, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.
Transform UGC, influencer content, product footage, and internal footage into high-performing paid ads.
Develop multiple hook variations, creative angles, pacing structures, and messaging approaches.
Structure videos using clear problem → solution → outcome frameworks.
Create UGC-style and influencer-style ads that feel authentic while driving action.
Identify and extract the strongest moments from longer footage.
Repurpose and remix existing footage into multiple testable creative variations.
Write and apply clear, compelling, and readable on-screen copy.
Create different versions of ads to test hooks, openings, messaging, pacing, CTAs, and visual approaches.
Optimize creative based on performance data, including CTR, thumb-stop rate, retention, watch time, and conversion performance.
Continuously analyze what is working and use those insights to improve future creative.




2) Creative Strategy & Content Direction 

You will not only edit what you are given. You will also help determine what content should be created next.

Identify creative opportunities based on product benefits, customer pain points, offers, trends, and performance data.
Develop creative concepts and ad angles that can be tested.
Create clear creative briefs and content request documents.
Recommend the types of footage, clips, shots, hooks, and messaging needed from the founder, internal team, or UGC creators.
Suggest improvements to framing, pacing, messaging, storytelling, and visual direction.
Help create repeatable creative frameworks and playbooks for producing high-performing ads.
Contribute ideas for new creative concepts rather than waiting for direction on every project.




3) UGC & Organic Content Support

Paid ads are the primary focus, but you may also support broader short-form content when needed.

Edit short-form product and website videos to improve conversion rate.
Turn influencer and internal footage into organic-style content.
Support TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
Add captions, transitions, sound design, motion graphics, and branded elements.
Collaborate with the Social Media Manager on trends, content direction, and creative ideas.
Repurpose existing content across multiple platforms and formats.




4) Speed, Testing & Execution

This is a high-output role.

Work quickly and prioritize execution over perfection.
Produce multiple creative variations within short timelines.
Move quickly from idea → edit → feedback → launch → iteration.
Implement feedback quickly and effectively.
Maintain strong organization, deadlines, and accountability.
Continuously test new hooks, angles, formats, and editing styles.
Be comfortable creating content that may not work and learning from the results.
Maintain a high level of responsiveness and creative output.




5) Organization & Creative Systems 

You will be expected to keep creative workflows organized and scalable.

Maintain organized Google Drive folders and creative assets.
Keep projects, footage, versions, and final files clearly organized.
Build and maintain creative playbooks, SOPs, and repeatable workflows.
Create clear request documents and creative briefs.
Help establish systems that make the creative process faster and easier to scale.




6) Platform & Trend Awareness

Stay current with TikTok, Meta, Instagram, and UGC advertising trends.
Understand how creative performance differs across platforms.
Track cultural and viral hooks relevant to U.S. audiences.
Identify trends that can be adapted to sell products.
Bring trend-aware ideas that are strategically relevant, not simply trends for the sake of following trends.




What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who thinks like both an editor and a marketer.

Has experience editing paid advertisements or high-performing short-form content.
Understands hooks, pacing, retention, storytelling, and buyer psychology.
Can create UGC-style ads that feel authentic and persuasive.
Has a KPI-driven mindset and cares about results, not just aesthetics.
Is highly organized and comfortable managing multiple creative projects.
Moves quickly and can produce a high volume of creative.
Is proactive and capable of working independently.
Is comfortable receiving direct feedback and making fast iterations.
Can identify problems in a piece of creative and recommend how to improve it.
Takes ownership of projects from concept through execution.
Thinks like a growth operator, not just an editor.




You take ownership. You move fast. You think about the customer. And you understand that the best creative is creative that performs. 




Must-Have Skills

Experience editing short-form video content and/or paid advertisements.
Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar editing software.
Proven ability to structure short-form content for engagement and conversion.
Ability to identify the strongest moments and hooks from raw footage.
Strong understanding of on-screen copy and messaging.
Understanding of how creative impacts CTR, ROAS, retention, and conversion performance.
Ability to suggest improvements to framing, pacing, storytelling, and creative direction.
Strong communication and organizational skills.
Fluent English.

*Motion graphics and AI video production experience are a plus.

*Tools: Nanabanana pro, adobe premier pro, capcut pro, Higgsfield ai, eleven labs, Runway, motion, figma and HeyGen.




Performance & Accountability

This role will be evaluated based on both creative output and measurable creative impact. Key performance indicators may include:

Click-through rate (CTR)
Thumb-stop and scroll-stop performance
Video retention and watch time
Conversion performance
Testing velocity
Quality and variety of creative iterations
Contribution to ad efficiency and scale
Ability to consistently produce and improve high-performing creative

Your edits are expected to drive results, not simply look good.




Benefits & Growth

Fully remote role, work from anywhere.
Full-time or part-time opportunity.
Flexible working hours with a focus on performance and results.
Performance-based bonuses, with total compensation reaching $1,700+ USD/month.
Fast-growing startup environment.
High level of creative ownership.
Opportunity to work directly with a growing DTC brand.
Free TopFoxx products.
Paid time off and company holidays.
Long-term growth opportunity into senior performance creative, creative strategy, or creative leadership.




How to Apply:

Send us your resume and portfolio to recruiting@topfoxx.com along with examples of short-form video content, paid advertisements, UGC-style videos, or other relevant work.




If you're passionate about using creativity to drive real business results and take action, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
About the job
